email.body1:
Cameron, saw Filevine raise $400M at a $3B valuation and add Pincites and Parrot to the AI legal stack.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before the new motions ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cameron, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and recovering a quarter is far harder than covering it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cameron, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other legal software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cameron, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
